The Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences (KNAW) has chosen three young researchers from the University of Amsterdam and Amsterdam UMC as recipients of Early Career Awards. The laureates are developmental ...

Vidi grants for ten talented UvA researchers
NWO has awarded Vidi grants to ten researchers from the UvA and Amsterdam UMC. The grants amount to a maximum of €850,000. This will enable the researchers to further develop their own line of research and to set up ...
